n: iRobot Education Coding app and Root simulator
t: A free coding app with a simulated Root robot and three coding levels.
steps: Open the coding web app or install the app from your device's store.
Confirm that the app is still available. The Root line changed owners in 2024.
Check what accounts are needed. The materials do not confirm this.
Open the simulator and run a first program.
Download the lesson PDFs if they are still offered.
Start students at the block level.
Move to text code when students are ready.
